{{Quote|Ah. That's the best one of the lot. A nobleman's son skipped bail. Looks like you're headed for the ocean dunes of Karnac.|Greef Karga, on the Mon Calamari|<ref name="Chapter 3" />}}
A [[Mon Calamari]] [[Unidentified Mon Calamari nobleman|nobleman's]] '''son''' was wanted by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] after skipping bail and hiding in the [[ocean]] dunes of [[Karnac]]. A [[bounty]] was later placed on him, whose [[Holopuck|puck]] was acquired by the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]]<ref name="Chapter 3" /> in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date Note">{{MandoDate|3}}</ref> The bounty was abandoned by Djarin after he decided to [[Incident on Nevarro|rescue]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] from an [[Imperial Remnant safe house|Imperial facility]].<ref name="Chapter 3" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mon Calamari appeared in a [[hologram]] in [[Chapter 3: The Sin|Chapter 3]] of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Chapter 3" /> which aired on [[November 22]], 2019.<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}}</ref>
